items.excerpt: ## Army Publishes New Map Showing Lead Dust from Munitions Plant Detonation Could Spread to Missouri Nov 25, 2026 Iowa Governor Kim Reynolds has declared a disaster emergency in three counties, as the U.S. Army prepares to detonate nearly five tons of highly unstable lead-based explosives at an ammunition plant in southeastern Iowa today. Environmental groups are warning of an unfolding public health catastrophe, with a detonation scheduled for 9 a.m. Central Time that could spew toxic lead dust across communities, farmland and potentially into the Mississippi River. Officials have recommended that residents of Middletown, where the plant is located, and anyone within a five-mile cone southwest of the plant evacuate, while people living up to 20 miles away have been told to stay indoors with their windows closed. This is Sean Kaufman, a disaster preparedness official with the Department of Health and Human Services. > Sean Kaufman: “Individuals that are in that directly affected area — which, again, we will continuously get updates based on the weather — if they are women who are pregnant, children under the age of 6, or children in general, and individuals who may have chronic disease, you definitely want to be out of that area. I would evacuate that area.” The Army published an updated map estimating the lead plume could spread all the way to northern Missouri, more than 100 miles from ground zero. There is no safe level of exposure to lead, a neurotoxin that can cause permanent cognitive and behavioral harm. Ahead of today’s detonation, The New York Times published an investigation revealing the Army had initially hired a firm to turn the explosives into harmless waste, but then dropped the contract in favor of a so-called controlled blast. We’ll have the latest on this story after headlines. ## Gaza Health Officials Warn of Spread of Meningitis as Israel Continues to Violate Ceasefire Deal Nov 25, 2026 In Gaza, at least four Palestinians were killed this morning in an Israeli airstrike on an apartment building in the al-Shati refugee camp. The strike followed Israeli attacks that killed at least 10 Palestinians across Gaza on Tuesday, including a 30-year-old pregnant mother and Khaled Walid al-Jamal, a 13-year-old boy shot dead in northern Gaza City. Another Israeli airstrike killed a senior Hamas security official, along with his wife and their two teenage daughters. The relentless attacks came as Palestinians held funeral services in Khan Younis for three people killed in an Israeli strike on a police post. ... On Tuesday, Gaza’s Health Ministry declared an epidemic alert over a surge in meningitis, warning that hundreds of thousands of people are at risk of contracting the deadly condition. ## Yemen’s Houthis Strike Saudi Arabia’s Largest Refinery and Riyadh Skyscraper ... Ras Tanura is one of the largest refining complexes and oil export terminals in the world, with a capacity of over a half-million barrels per day. items.excerpt: EMBARGOED UNTIL RELEASE AT 8:30 a.m. EST, Wednesday, November 25, 2026 # GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 3rd Quarter 2026 Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 4.3 percent in the third quarter of 2026 (July, August, and September), according to the second estimate released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). In the second quarter, real GDP increased 2.2 percent. The contributors to the increase in real GDP in the third quarter were increases in investment, consumer spending, and government spending that were partly offset by a decrease in exports. Imports, which are a subtraction in the calculation of GDP, increased. Real GDP was revised up 0.9 percentage point from the advance estimate, primarily reflecting upward revisions to investment and consumer spending. For more information, refer to the " Technical Notes" below. Compared to the second quarter, the acceleration in real GDP in the third quarter primarily reflected an acceleration in investment and an upturn in government spending that were partly offset by a downturn in exports. Imports increased more in the third quarter than in the second quarter. Real final sales to private domestic purchasers, the sum of consumer spending and gross private fixed investment, increased 5.8 percent in the third quarter, revised up 0.9 percentage point from the previous estimate. The price index for gross domestic purchases increased 2.7 percent in the third quarter, revised down 0.3 percentage point from the previous estimate. The personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index increased 2.1 percent, and the PCE price index, excluding food and energy increased 2.5 percent, both the same as previously estimated. Real gross domestic income (GDI) increased 4.4 percent in the third quarter, compared with an increase of 2.3 percent (revised) in the second quarter. items.title: Ariana Grande unveils concert film and tour documentary
items.excerpt: The pop icon, 33, announced on Tuesday, November 24, that a concert film and a documentary chronicling the making of her Eternal Sunshine Tour will both arrive on Peacock next month. Titled Eternal Sunshine Diaries: The Making of the Tour, the documentary will premiere on December 11, followed by The Eternal Sunshine Tour on December 12. The behind-the-scenes project follows Grande during the 30 days leading up to her tour opener, capturing the Grammy-winner and her team racing to prepare the ambitious production. It also offers a glimpse into her creative process as she puts the finishing touches on her eighth studio album. Meanwhile, the concert film promises to take viewers through the emotional journey behind her performances, exploring themes of healing, reconnection and personal growth.
